text.agent-run.ts: Runs Claude or Codex agents and displays shared progress and cancellation, including the repair of one plan file, buffering Codex events until the run id is known
text.cli-panel.ts: Settings panel that shows whether the lantern command is installed, installs it, and explains replacing a command it did not create by hand
text.update-notice.ts: Shows the update notice card the main process pushes, with its two buttons, and sends the pressed button's action back.
text.editor-tab.ts: Watches embedded editor readiness and manages retry loading covers
text.explain.ts: Displays change explainers with sanitised markdown, quizzes and highlighted code references previewed from the project, and registers the explain.popout command while it is open
text.memory.ts: Opens and closes the memory dialog (button, backdrop or Escape), starting main-process sampling while it is open and stopping it when it closes, and returning focus to where it was
text.integrations.ts: Opens the Integrations dialog: GitHub, Bitbucket and Jira sections, each with its logo, their accounts and an add-account form, a button that jumps to the project list below them and a wrapping grid of project tiles that each open one project's account choices, showing the window's selected project first and keeping focus inside and giving it back to what opened it
text.integrations.ts gotcha: Escape closes an open add or edit form first and the dialog only when no form has focus.
text.lantern.ts: Hosts project map tabs (telling each view its project so the review layout is remembered per project, and re-checking the full-window Planning mode whenever a tab comes to the front or goes), resumable setup, remote pull request refresh whose reload button also drops the host status cache and keeps keyboard focus, the review view's Refresh (which makes the main process fetch, drop its pull request cache and reload before the map loads again) and the background revalidation when a pull request is entered (which reloads the map only when the data changed), the live graph folding setting, the macro view read for the graph, and the explain-a-file client for the review pane, labelled for the project's chosen assistant, the local-review actions (pick a branch or commit range to compare, remove it, generate its reasons, reporting a failed reasons run in the problems list, open one saved from the command line), the copy and fix-with-an-agent actions for plan files, fed by the agent run (also on the problems-list warning of a broken plan), and per panel a head row (the pull request tabs strip, Refresh map, reload) above a bottom status bar with the problems list (map errors and warnings, a failed run, a failed reasons run, a failed remote fetch and the unfinished-setup notice, with files opening in the code viewer), the session state of each session labelled with its own assistant, the map stats, the per-provider integration icons that open the Integrations dialog on that project, and an assistant picker, the panel freed when it is closed and no run is going, and the commands behind Problems and Refresh map, the previous and next file step passed to the active project's map view, the per-file line counts read for a pull request, and announcing to the window whenever a map comes to the front or leaves it
text.provider-control.ts: Lets a project choose Claude or Codex for Lantern tools and sets up, refreshes or removes Codex activity hooks, and builds the keyboard-navigable assistant picker (mountProviderButton) for the Lantern status bar, which is repainted when the choice changes and removed with its panel
text.load-screen.ts: Builds the reusable editor loading progress and retry screen, with a Show diagnostics link on a failed start
text.diagnostics-notice.ts: Shows the one-time card after a crash, with Report on GitHub and Dismiss, and never opens the browser by itself
text.diagnostics-notice.ts gotcha: Reporting from the card needs the pending notice in main, so it works only before it is dismissed.
text.diagnostics.ts: Opens and closes the Diagnostics dialog, starts the live watch while it is open and wires the view to copy a report and report on GitHub
text.rtk-panel.ts: Settings panel that shows whether RTK is installed, its path, version and edition, and warns about a set RTK hook, without any button that changes it
text.server-load.ts: Shows editor server startup progress and restart recovery
text.settings.ts: Opens the Settings dialog from the Settings command or the My profile menu, keeps focus inside it, lets Escape revert an unsaved edit before closing but leaves keys typed in another dialog opened above it to that dialog, saves changes through IPC, reports failures, plays a notification sound at the current volume when a sound choice is previewed, adds the command line and RTK panels, and closes every open dialog before another one opens
text.settings.ts gotcha: Opening a dialog closes every open modal, Settings included, by clicking its close button
text.skills-extras-step.ts: Draws the modal step for adding a skill to a role: a name field, a Global or This project choice when a project is open, and a content text area, a Save that refuses an empty, bad, locked or repeated name before asking the main process to write the skill in that scope, shows its refusal or a failed call in the step, and a Back that writes nothing.
text.skills-extras.ts: Mounts two views of the Skills modal and runs their saves. Lantern skills hands the loaded panel to the role board and turns its attach, detach, move, switch, import and add-skill actions into one save call each, announcing the change in a live region and restoring the focus. Skill linker shows only the path field to set or clear and its state: Initialized, Not set or the reason the path is invalid. Both show a refused write's message, a damaged project file by name or a failed save and ignore clicks while a save is in flight. Each redraw of the board keeps the modal body and both lists at the scroll position they had, and a changed role starts its lists from the top.
text.skills-roles.ts: Draws the Lantern skills board: a role selector, a column of the skills attached to the chosen role with a closed Built in group of always-on skills and on/off switches, and a searchable column of the skills that can be attached, with a Global or This project choice while a project is open. It owns the keyboard: arrows, Home and End, Enter to attach or change scope, Delete to detach, and the chosen role, search text and scope, kept while the window stays open.
text.skills-rows.ts: Builds the rows of the board: an attached skill with its Global or This project badge, a not-installed warning and a Detach button, an attachable skill that says what pressing it does or why it is disabled (attached, or built in), and the locked and switchable always-on rows
text.skills-segmented.ts: Draws a radio group of buttons with one tab stop and arrow, Home and End keys, used for the role selector and the scope choice
text.skills-shortcuts.ts: Focuses the board's search box on a slash outside a text field and on Ctrl or Cmd plus F, while the board is on screen
text.skills-state.ts: Classifies skill rows as bundled, local, linked or available, words skipped-link notices and works out, from the lists the main process sends, a role's always-on rows, which of them are switchable and which are off, its attached skills (global first, then the project's, each once, with scope and a missing flag), the skills that can be attached with the scope each is attached in and the built-in names a search matches, the default scope, and keyboard movement
text.skills.ts: Manages project skill links (a skill with no group gets no group header), repository setup, enables the microphone through the Enable mic button, which waits for the native warning and shows its busy and enabled states only when the user confirmed, exports openSkills and fixMicrophone for the commands that run them, shows the skill views as three tabs that open with or without a skills repo or a project (Project skills with the role lists, Lantern skills with a Refresh button and a wider card, Skill linker, which also holds the skills repo path with Apply, Browse, Open folder, remote, version with its refresh button, and status, and, while the repo is missing, the clone prompt with an empty input for the user's own remote URL, whose clone button stays disabled with a hint until a remote URL is typed or known) and remembers the open tab, swaps the modal to the add-skill step and back to the Lantern skills tab, reloading when the assistant changes, and keeps the body's scroll position when the same tab redraws after an action or a refresh
text.explain.ts gotcha: The explain.popout command exists only while the dialog is open, and never in a pop-out window
text.lantern.ts gotcha: Closing the tab during a run keeps the panel alive until the run ends, then frees it
text.provider-control.ts gotcha: The picker changes the assistant by driving the #provider-select control, so it does nothing without it
text.explain.ts = src/preload/workspace.ts: lists and removes explainers and reads a referenced file for preview
